title: Location of Curb Cuts
previewText: Curb cuts are permitted only in the locations indicated on Map 10 (Permitted Curb Cut Locations) in Appendix A of this Chapter. The aggregate width of all curb cuts provided for any building shall not exceed 50 feet.
